name: faq_followup
turns: How long does international shipping take?
scenario: User asks about international shipping, then asks about delivery time.
ground_truth: Agent should confirm international shipping is available and state it usually takes 7-14 business days.

name: refund_policy_then_personalized
turns: Can I return a custom engraved item?
scenario: User asks about refund window, then asks about personalized items.
ground_truth: Agent should say refunds must be requested within 30 days of delivery, and personalized/custom items are non-refundable.

name: order_status_lookup
scenario: User asks to see orders, then asks for status of order 2.
ground_truth: Agent should show order 2 (Running Shoes) is shipped with tracking info.

name: refund_flow
scenario: User wants a refund, identifies order 3 (delivered laptop), asks about eligibility.
ground_truth: Agent should confirm order 3 (Laptop) is eligible for a refund within the 30-day window.

name: track_then_policy
turns: How can I track my order?
Also, how long do refunds take to process?
scenario: User asks about order tracking, then asks about refund processing time.
ground_truth: Agent should explain tracking via account/orders page and that refunds take 5-7 business days after approval.
